title: Covenant
summary: Post a token-funded job, let a taker accept and submit work, then finalize payment after the challenge period.
what: Covenant is an Anchor 0.30.1 optimistic escrow for agent jobs. init_config (restricted to the program upgrade authority) writes a singleton config PDA (seeds ["config"]) with an arbitrator set and challenge-period bounds. create_job (seeds ["job", poster, spec_hash]) locks tokens in a PDA token account (seeds ["escrow_token", job]). The taker accept_job then submit_work, which starts the challenge clock. finalize_payment is permissionless once that clock expires and no dispute is active; it pays the taker (or a sold claim buyer), credits reputation, and closes the job.
app_note: The page at /dapps/covenant/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/covenant-protocol. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique lab program.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/covenant/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. The lab already ran init_config, create_job, accept_job, submit_work and finalize_payment for 1_000_000 lab tokens with a 1-second challenge period.
try_steps.see: Program 6ftEd3uT…. Job 9SncPbxr… should be closed; taker C8Kh4ewr… received 1_000_000.

diagram: admin --init_config--> config; poster --create_job--> job+escrow_token; taker --accept_job/submit_work--> Delivered; anyone --finalize_payment--> taker ATA, job closed.
accounts: claim listing PDA seeds ["claim", job] (uninitialized in the happy path)
innovation: Payment is delayed until the challenge period expires, and finalize_payment always sees the deterministic claim-listing PDA so a sold claim cannot be skipped.
exercises: Derive the job PDA from poster and spec_hash.
What account must sign init_config besides the admin?
